label: Every absence of an actual root is excluded by some ESSENCE_6 condition
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every actual concrete root r at w and every determination d that r lacks at w, some ESSENCE_6 condition on r's profile (in some being's nature) fails at every set of determinations containing r's real determinations together with d. Essentialism about a root's absences with no modal premise: unlike essence-grounded modality (f6f956a1) and necessity of root absences (906f9077) it mentions no accessible world. A necessary lack that no nature grounds (modal primitivism or brutalism) denies it; a bare negative clause in the root's nature satisfies it. A classical root whose selection of one outcome is a real intrinsic determination that varies across worlds satisfies it through an admissibility condition excluding a second selection (essentialExclusionControls, row 5).
